description: DB integration: publish and submit store-only; assert exact versioned payload/metadata/attachments, succeeded status, and null ticket/workflow ids.
DB integration side-effect guard: store-only creates zero tickets, workflow runs, ticket events, and ticket notifications while retaining submission search events.
DB integration compatibility: an existing/default ticket-only definition stores its response and creates exactly one ticket.
DB integration idempotency: sequential and concurrent same-key requests return one submission and invoke the provider at most once; distinct keys remain distinct.
DB integration authorization: own-client portal and authorized MSP reads succeed; foreign client and tenant reads fail closed.
Behavioral UI test: select Store only, verify explanatory copy and hidden ticket routing, publish, reload, and retain selection.
Behavioral history test: store-only row and detail show response metadata/answers without an error or ticket link.
DB guard: required-field or invalid-attachment submission fails before persistence and produces no downstream side effect.
